stories.title: Más de 40 mil personas participan en el Segundo Simulacro Nacional 2026 en alcaldía Benito Juárez; reportan saldo blanco

en.title: Over 40,000 people participate in Second National Drill 2026 in Benito Juárez borough; report successful outcome
en.summary: More than 40,000 participants evacuated shopping centers, businesses, and residences during a national earthquake drill in Mexico City's Benito Juárez borough with no reported incidents.

stories.title: Trump creará una "fuerza de la IA"; anuncia que habrá un zar de la inteligencia artificial

en.title: Trump to create an "AI force"; announces artificial intelligence czar
en.summary: Trump announced plans to establish a dedicated artificial intelligence force and appoint a czar to oversee the initiative.

stories.title: Participan 33 millones de mexicanos en Segundo Simulacro Nacional 2026, reporta la CNPC; hospitalizan a una persona por infarto

en.title: 33 million Mexicans participate in Second National Drill 2026, reports CNPC; one person hospitalized for heart attack
en.summary: A national earthquake drill involved 33 million Mexican participants, with civil protection authorities reporting one hospitalization for a heart attack and another person receiving medical attention after a fall in Mexico City.

stories.title: Simulacro Nacional 2026: alerta sísmica funciona en 98.93% de altavoces de CDMX

en.title: National Drill 2026: seismic alert functions in 98.93% of speakers in Mexico City
en.summary: Mexico City's seismic alert system operated successfully on 98.93 percent of speakers during a national drill simulating a 7.7 magnitude earthquake, with an average evacuation time of one minute and 43 seconds.

stories.title: Segundo Simulacro Nacional 2026: Realizan ejercicios de crisis en Monumento a la Revolución; participaron 472 elementos federales, locales, voluntarios y civiles

en.title: Second National Drill 2026: Crisis exercises held at Monument to the Revolution; 472 federal, local, volunteer and civilian personnel participated
en.summary: Mexico conducted a national crisis exercise at a major monument with nearly 500 participants from various agencies and volunteer groups. The drill involved five different emergency scenarios.

stories.title: Concluye Segundo Simulacro Nacional 2026 en CDMX; participaron más de 7 millones de personas

en.title: Second National Drill 2026 concludes in Mexico City; more than 7 million people participated
en.summary: A nationwide preventive exercise in Mexico City involved over 7 million participants. During the drill, one person experienced a heart attack and another received medical attention after falling down stairs.

stories.title: Reportan poca participación de vecinos del Rébsamen en el Segundo Simulacro Nacional 2026; se ha ido olvidando la tragedia, señala ciudadano

en.title: Low participation from Rébsamen residents reported in Second National Drill 2026; citizen notes that tragedy is being forgotten
en.summary: Residents near a former school building showed limited participation in a national earthquake drill. When seismic alerts sounded, nearby residents remained inside their homes rather than evacuating.

stories.title: Liga MX: ¿Qué partidos del Apertura 2026 se jugarán este sábado, 19 de septiembre?

en.title: Liga MX: What Apertura 2026 matches will be played this Saturday, September 19?
en.summary: Four Liga MX matches are scheduled for Saturday, September 19, with three of them being broadcast on open television.

stories.title: Sheinbaum agradece participación en el Simulacro Nacional 2026: "La prevención es nuestra fuerza"

en.title: Sheinbaum thanks participation in 2026 National Drill: "Prevention is our strength"
en.summary: Mexico's president acknowledged participation in a nationwide earthquake simulation exercise. The drill tested emergency response protocols across the country.

stories.title: Simulacro Nacional 2026 EN VIVO: concluye ejercicio de este 19 de septiembre

en.title: 2026 National Drill LIVE: earthquake simulation exercise concludes on September 19
en.summary: Mexico completed its second national earthquake simulation drill on Saturday, September 19. The exercise tested emergency response procedures and coordination among authorities nationwide.

stories.title: EN VIVO | Segundo Simulacro Nacional 2026: Sigue el minuto a minuto del ejercicio de este sábado 19 de septiembre

en.title: LIVE | Second 2026 National Drill: Follow minute-by-minute coverage of Saturday, September 19 exercise
en.summary: Mexico's second national earthquake simulation drill took place on September 19 at 12:00 central time. The exercise tested emergency preparedness and response coordination across the country.

stories.title: Batman Day 2026: cine gratis, maratones y actividades para celebrar este 19 de septiembre

en.title: Batman Day 2026: free movies, marathons and activities to celebrate this September 19
en.summary: Batman Day is celebrated on Saturday with free film screenings in Mexico City, movie marathons, comic book releases, and special video game activities.

stories.title: 10 millones de dispositivos y menos de cinco segundos, la carrera de SkyAlert ante un sismo

en.title: 10 million devices and less than five seconds, SkyAlert's race against an earthquake
en.summary: SkyAlert's earthquake alert system uses sensors, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing to detect earthquakes and distribute alerts to millions of devices in seconds. The technology analyzes potential impact before sending notifications.

stories.title: Registro telefónico llega a 54.7%, mientras las fallas en plataformas aún complican la vinculación

en.title: Telephone Registration Reaches 54.7%, While Platform Failures Continue to Complicate Linking
en.summary: More than half of active telephone lines are now registered, but technical issues with platforms persist in hindering users from completing the linking process.

stories.title: Tim Hortons reta a Starbucks con tazas de Halloween y se adelanta al vaso de Snoopy

en.title: Tim Hortons challenges Starbucks with Halloween cups and gets ahead of Snoopy glass
en.summary: Tim Hortons launched Halloween-themed cups before Starbucks, with both coffee chains using limited-edition collectible cups as a strategy to attract customers and increase sales.

stories.title: Hacienda continúa con baja de impuestos a gasolinas, diésel va por segunda semana con cero IEPS

en.title: Treasury continues with gasoline tax cuts, diesel enters second week with zero IEPS
en.summary: Mexico's Treasury is offering a 100% discount on the IEPS fuel tax for diesel from September 19-25, extending a tax relief measure for the second consecutive week.

stories.title: Trump anuncia acuerdo por Groenlandia: “otorga a Estados Unidos el control permanente sobre la seguridad”

en.title: Trump announces deal for Greenland: "grants the United States permanent control over security"
en.summary: The White House announced an agreement regarding Greenland involving increased US military presence and restrictions on adversaries, though Denmark maintains the territory's sovereignty.
